column3: pāṇigrahe pulakitaṃ vapur aiśaṃ bhūtibhūṣitaṃ jayati |
mā vama saṃvṛṇu viṣam idam iti sātaṅkaṃ pitāmahenoktaḥ |
dhanuṣi smareṇa nihitaḥ sakaṇṭakaḥ ketakeṣur iva ||
puruṣāyitam abhyasyati lakṣmīr yad vīkṣya mukuram iva ||
sa jayati yena kṛtā śrīr anurūpā padmanābhasya ||
ādāya saptatantrocitāṃ vipañcīm iva trayīṃ gāyan |
sa jayati mahābāho jalanidhijaṭhare ciraṃ nimagnāpi |
yenāntrair iva saha phaṇigaṇair balād uddhṛtā dharaṇī ||
yasyāś candraśikhaḥ smarabhallanibho jayati sā caṇḍī ||
tān asurān api harim api taṃ vande kapaṭakaiṭabhīrūpam |
yair yad bimbādharamadhulubdhaiḥ pīyūṣam api mumuce ||
yābhir anaṅgaḥ sāṅgīkṛtaḥ striyo .strīkṛtāś ca tā yena |
śakrāyudham iva vakraṃ valmīkabhuvaṃ kaviṃ naumi ||
vyāsagirāṃ niryāsaṃ sāraṃ viśvasya bhārataṃ vande |
bhūṣaṇāyaiva sañjñāṃ yad aṅkitāṃ bhāratī vahati ||
rohati kulyā gaṅgāpūre kiṃ bahurase vahati ||
kair nocyeta guṇāḍhyaḥ sa eva janmāntarāpannaḥ ||
trisrotā iva sarasā sarasvatī sphurati yair bhinnā ||
bhavabhūteḥ sambandhād bhūdharabhūr eva bhāratī bhāti |
jātā śikhaṇḍinī prāg yathā śikhaṇḍī tathāvagacchāmi |
prāgalbhyam adhikam āptuṃ vāṇī bāṇo babhūveti ||
yaṃ gaṇayati guror anu yasyās te dharmakarma saṃkucitam |
kavim aham uśanasam iva taṃ tātaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ vande ||
sakalakalāḥ kalpayituṃ prabhuḥ prabandhasya kumudabandhoś ca |
kāvyasyākṣaramaitrībhājo na ca karkaśā na ca grāmyāḥ |
śabdā api puruṣā api sādhava evārthabodhāya ||
vaṃśe ghuṇa iva na viśati doṣo rasabhāvite satāṃ manasi |
rasam api tu na pratīcchati bahudoṣaḥ saṃnipātīva ||
viguṇo .pi kāvyabandhaḥ sādhūnām ānanaṃ gataḥ svadate |
svayam api bhūricchidraś cāpalam api sarvatomukhaṃ tanvan |
sandarbhasya nadasya ca na rasaḥ prītyai rasajñānām ||
surasārthamayaṃ kāvyaṃ triviṣṭapaṃ vā samaṃ vidmaḥ ||
tṛpto dayitādharam api nādriyate kā sudhā dāsī ||
adhvani padagrahaparaṃ madayati hṛdayaṃ na vā na vā śravaṇam |
dūtīrahitā iva te na kāminīmanasi niviśante ||
arasā sālaṅkṛtir api na rocate śālabhañjīva ||
ayi vividhavacanaracane dadāsi candraṃ kare samānīya |
vyasanadivaseṣu dūti kva punas tvaṃ darśanīyāsi ||
astu mlānir loko lāñchanam apadiśatu hīyatām ojaḥ |
tad api na muñcati sa tvāṃ vasudhāchāyām iva sudhāṃśuḥ ||
mukharayasi svayam etāṃ sadvṛttāṃ śaṅkur iva ghaṇṭām ||
ayi koṣakāra kuruṣe vanecarāṇāṃ puro guṇodgāram |
yan na vidārya vicāritajaṭharas tvaṃ sa khalu te lābhaḥ ||
aparādhād adhikaṃ māṃ vyathayati tava kapaṭavacanaracaneyam |
asatīlocanamukure kim api pratiphalati yan manovarti |
sārasvatam api cakṣuḥ satimiram iva tan na lakṣayati ||
anyamukhe durvādo yaḥ priyavadane sa eva parihāsaḥ |
tvayi mohāya varākī patitā madhupīva viṣakusume ||
upabhuñjate kareṇūḥ kevalam iha matkuṇāḥ kariṇaḥ ||
antargatair guṇaiḥ kiṃ dvitrā api yatra sākṣiṇo viralāḥ |
sa guṇo gīter yad asau vanecaraṃ hariṇam api harati ||
alulitasakalavibhūṣāṃ prātar bālāṃ vilokya muditaṃ prāk |
priyaśirasi vīkṣya yāvakam atha niḥśvasitaṃ sapatnībhiḥ ||
jinasiddhāntasthitir iva savāsanā kaṃ na mohayati ||
alam aviṣayabhayalajjāvañcitam ātmānam iyam iyat samayam |
tadgatim icchantyaḥ sakhi bhavanti viphalaśramāḥ hāsyāḥ ||
adhikaḥ sarvebhyo yaḥ priyaḥ priyebhyo hṛdi sthitaḥ satatam |
sa luṭhati virahe jīvaḥ kaṇṭhe.syās tvam iva sambhoge ||
anayanapathe priye na vyathā yathā dṛśya eva duṣprāpe |
mlānaiva kevalaṃ niśi tapanaśilā vāsare jvalati ||
rahasi vyapadeśād ayam arthaḥ ivārājake bhogyaḥ ||
aśrauṣīr aparādhān mama tathyaṃ kathaya manmukhaṃ vīkṣya |
abhidhīyate na kiṃ yadi na mānacaurānanaḥ kitavaḥ ||
anyonyam anusrotasam anyad athānyat taṭāt taṭaṃ bhajatoḥ |
añjalir akāri lokair mlānim anāptaiva rañjitā jagatī |
sandhyāyā iva vasatiḥ svalpāpi sakhe sukhāyaiva ||
agṛhītānunayāṃ mām upekṣya sakhyo gatā bataikāham |
prasabhaṃ karoṣi mayi cet tvad upari vapur adya mokṣyāmi ||
asthirarāgaḥ kitavo mānī capalo vidūṣakas tvam asi |
mama sakhyāḥ patasi kare paśyāmi yathā ṛjur bhavasi ||
tvām anu dhāvati vimukhaṃ gaṅgeva bhagīrathaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ ||
apy unmukhasya vihitā varavarṇini na tvayā tṛptiḥ ||
guṇagarvitā punar asau hasati śanaiḥ śuṣkaruditamukhī ||
aṅke niveśya kūṇitadṛśaḥ śanair akaruṇeti śaṃsantyāḥ |
abudhā ajaṅgamā api kayāpi gatyā paraṃ padam avāptāḥ |
mantriṇa iti kīrtyante nayabalaguṭikā iva janena ||
anyāsv api gṛhiṇīti dhyāyann abhilaṣitam āpnoti |
asyāḥ premṇaḥ pātraṃ na bhavasi sarito rasasyeva ||
adhivāsanam ādheyaṃ guṇamārgam apekṣate na ca grathanām |
agaṇitaguṇena sundara kṛtvā cāritram apy udāsīnam |
ardhaḥ prāṇity eko mṛta itaro me vidhuntudasyeva |
apamānitam iva samprati guruṇā grīṣmeṇa durbalaṃ śaityam |
alasayati gātram akhilaṃ kleśaṃ mocayati locanaṃ harati |
svāpa iva preyān mama moktuṃ na dadāti śayanīyam ||
dhautādharanayanaṃ vapur astram anaṅgasya tava niśitam ||
avinihitaṃ vinihitam iva yuvasu svaccheṣu vāravāmadṛśaḥ |
atilajjayā tvayaiva prakaṭaḥ preyān akāri nibhṛto .pi |
khalam api tudanti meḍhībhūtaṃ madhyastham ālambya ||
ananugraheṇa na tathā vyathayati kaṭukūjitair yathā piśunaḥ |
rudhirādānād adhikaṃ dunoti karṇe kvaṇan maśakaḥ ||
agre laghimā paścān mahatāpi pidhīyate na hi mahimnā |
aṅke stanandhayas tava caraṇe paricārikā priyaḥ pṛṣṭhe |
asti kimu labhyam adhikaṃ gṛhiṇi yadā śaṅkase bālām ||
adhara udastaḥ kūjitam āmīlitam akṣi lolito mauliḥ |
cātaka iva navam abhraṃ nirīkṣamāṇo na tṛpyāmi ||
antarbhūto nivasati jaḍe jaḍaḥ śiśiramahasi hariṇa iva |
ajaḍe śaśīva tapane sa tu praviṣṭo .pi niḥsarati ||
jyākārmukayoḥ kaścid guṇabhūtaḥ kaścid api bhartā ||
jyām arpayituṃ namitā kusumāstradhanur lateva madhu ||
asatī kulajā dhīrā prauḍhā prativeśinī yad āsaktim |
kurute sarasā ca tadā brahmānandaṃ tṛṇaṃ manye ||
aviralapatitāśru vapuḥ pāṇḍu snigdhaṃ tavopanītam idam |
śatadhautam ājyam iva me smaraśaradāhavyathāṃ harati ||
amunā hatam idam idam iti rudatī prativeśine.ṅgam aṅgam iyam |
āntaram api bahiriva hi vyañjayituṃ rasam aśeṣataḥ satatam |
āloka eva vimukhī kvacid api divase na dakṣiṇā bhavasi |
chāyeva tad api tāpaṃ tvam eva me harasi mānavati ||
ājñā kākur yācñākṣepo hasitaṃ ca śuṣkaruditaṃ ca |
iti nidhuvanapāṇḍityaṃ dhyāyaṃs tasyā na tṛpyāmi ||
ājñāpayiṣyasi padaṃ dāsyasi dayitasya śirasi kiṃ tvarase |
asamayamānini mugdhe mā kuru bhagnāṅkuraṃ prema ||
ādaraṇīyaguṇā sakhi mahatā nihitāsi tena śirasi tvam |
ārdram api stanajaghanān nirasya sutanu tvayaitad unmuktam |
khastham avāptum iva tvāṃ tapanāṃśūn aṃśukaṃ pibati ||
āropitā śilāyām aśmeva tvaṃ bhaveti mantreṇa |
āyāti yāti khedaṃ karoti madhu harati madhukarīvānyā |
adhidevatā tvam eva śrīr iva kamalasya mama manasaḥ ||
āsādya dakṣiṇāṃ diśam avilambaṃ tyajati cottarāṃ taraṇiḥ |
puruṣaṃ haranti kāntāḥ prāyeṇa hi dakṣiṇā eva ||
ākṣipasi karṇam akṣṇā balir api baddhas tvayā tridhā madhye |
strīṇāṃ patir api gurur iti dharmaṃ na śrāvitā sutanuḥ ||
muṣitāsmi tena jaghanāṃśukam api voḍhuṃ naśaktena ||
ādāya dhanam analpaṃ dadānayā subhaga tāvakaṃ vāsaḥ |
mugdhā rajakagṛhiṇyā kṛtā dinaiḥ katipayair niḥsvā ||
āstāṃ varam avakeśī mā dohadamasya racaya pūgataroḥ |
etasmāt phalitād api kevalam udvegam adhigaccha ||
ārabdham abdhimathanaṃ svahastayitvā dvijihvam amarair yat |
ucitas tatpariṇāmo viṣamaṃ viṣam eva yajjātam ||
karṣati mano madīyaṃ hradamīnaṃ baḍiśarajjur iva ||
ālapa yathā yathecchasi yuktaṃ tava kitava kim apavārayasi |
āsvādito .si mohād bata viditā vadanamādhurī bhavataḥ |
dhanyena bhujamṛṇālaṃ grāhyaṃ madanasya rājyam iva ||
vātapratīcchanapaṭī vahitram iva harasi māṃ sutanu ||
ānayati pathikataruṇaṃ hariṇa iha prāpayann ivātmānam |
āsīd eva yad ārdraḥ kim api tadā kim ayam āhato .py āha |
niṣṭhurabhāvād adhunā kaṭūni sakhi raṭati paṭaha iva ||
ājñākaraś ca tāḍanaparibhavasahanaś ca satyam aham asyāḥ |
na tu śīlaśītaleyaṃ priyetarad vaktum api veda ||
āstāṃ mānaḥ kathanaṃ sakhīṣu vā mayi nivedyadurvinaye |
iyam udgatiṃ harantīnetranikocaṃ ca vidadhatī purataḥ |
na vijānīmaḥ kiṃ tava vadati sapatnīva dinanidrā ||
guṭikādhanur iva bālāvapuḥ smaraḥ śrayati kutukena ||
ikṣur nadīpravāho dyūtaṃ mānagrahaś ca he sutanu |
bhrūlatikā ca taveyaṃ bhaṅge rasam adhikam āvahati ||
indor ivāsya purato yad vimukhī sāpavāraṇā bhramasi |
tat kathaya kiṃ nu duritaṃ sakhi tvayā chāyayeva kṛtam ||
iha kapaṭakutukataralitadṛśi viśvāsaṃ kuraṅga kiṃ kuruṣe |
iha vahati bahu mahodadhivibhūṣaṇā mānagarvam iyam urvī |
devasya kamaṭhamūrteḥ na pṛṣṭhaṃ api nikhilam āpnoti ||
īṣad avaśiṣṭajaḍimā śiśire gatamātra eva ciram aṅgaiḥ |
acalā api na mahāntaḥ ke cañcalabhāvam ānītāḥ ||
upanīya yan nitambe bhujaṅgam uccair alambi vibudhaiḥ śrīḥ |
ekaḥ sa mandaragiriḥ sakhi garimāṇaṃ samudvahatu ||
adhunā niṣṭhuram api yadi sa vadati kalikaitavād yāmi ||
uḍḍīnānām eṣāṃ prāsādāt taruṇi pakṣiṇāṃ paṅktiḥ |
evam avataṃsam ākṣipad āhatadīpo yathā patati ||
udito .pi tuhinagahane gaganaprānte na dīpyate tapanaḥ |
aniśaṃ sa mohayati māṃ hṛllagnaḥ śvāsa iva dayitaḥ ||

column3: mandaragirir iva vibudhair itas tataḥ kṛṣyate kāyaḥ ||
upanīya kalamakuḍavaṃ kathayati sabhayaś cikitsake halikaḥ |
upari pariplavate mama bāleyaṃ gṛhiṇi haṃsamāleva |
sarasa iva nalinanālā tvam āśayaṃ prāpya vasasi punaḥ ||
upanīya priyamasamayavidaṃ ca me dagdhamānam apanīya |
ṛjunā nidhehi caraṇau parihara sakhi nikhilanāgarācāram |
ṛṣabho .tra gīyata iti śrutvā svarapāragā vayaṃ prāptāḥ |
viṣam amṛtaṃ vā samam iti yaḥ paśyan garalam eva papau ||
eṣyati mā punar ayam iti gamane yad amaṅgalaṃ mayākāri |
adhunā tad eva kāraṇam avasthitau dagdhagehapateḥ ||
viśrāmyati subhaga tvām aṅgulir āsādya merum iva ||
ekaḥ sa eva jīvati svahṛdayaśūnyo .pi sahṛdayo rāhuḥ |
yaḥ sakalalaghimakāraṇam udaraṃ na bibharti duṣpūram ||
ekena cūrṇakuntalam apareṇa kareṇa cibukam unnamayan |
ekaṃ jīvanamūlaṃ cañcalam api tāpayantam api satatam |
antar vahati varākī sā tvāṃ nāseva niḥśvāsam ||
ekaṃ vadati mano mama yāmi na yāmīti hṛdayam aparaṃ me |
kelinilayaṃ sakhīm iva nayati navoḍhāṃ svayaṃ na māṃ bhajate |
itthaṃ gṛhiṇīm arye stuvati prativeśinā hasitam ||
vṛddhir yathā yathā syās tathā tathā kaṇṭakotkarṣaḥ ||
vidhyasi māṃ niḥśvāsaiḥ smaraḥ śaraiḥ śabdavedhīva ||
kiṃcinna bālayoktaṃ na saprasādā niveśitā dṛṣṭiḥ |
mayi padapatite kevalam akāri śukapañjaro vimukhaḥ ||
kṣiptaḥ kṣipto nipatann aṅge nartayati bhṛṅgas tām ||
kim aśakanīyaṃ premṇaḥ phaṇinaḥ kathayāpi yā bibheti sma |

column3: kiṃ parvadivasam ārjitadantoṣṭhi nijaṃ vapur na maṇḍayasi |
sa tvāṃ tyajati na parvasv api madhurām ikṣuyaṣṭim iva ||
kaṣṭaṃ sāhasakāriṇi tava nayanārdhena so .dhvani spṛṣṭaḥ |
upavītād api vidito na dvijadehas tapasvī te ||
kūpaprabhavāṇāṃ param ucitam apāṃ paṭṭabandhanaṃ manye |
yāḥ śakyante labdhuṃ na pārthivenāpi viguṇena ||
ravir iva yantrollikhitaḥ kṛśo .pi lokasya harasi dṛśam ||
kiṃ karavāṇi divāniśam api lagnā sahajaśītalaprakṛtiḥ |
hanta sukhayāmi na priyam ātmānam ivātmanaś chāyā ||
dayitavahanena vakṣasi yadi bhāras tad idam acikitsyam ||
kiṃcitkarkaśatām anu rasaṃ pradāsyan nisargamadhuraṃ me |
ikṣor iva te sundari mānasya granthir api kāmyaḥ ||
kena giriśasya dattā buddhir bhujagaṃ jaṭāvane.rpayitum |
kurutāṃ cāpalam adhunā kalayatu surasāsi yādṛśī tad api |
kṛcchrānuvṛttayo .pi hi paropakāraṃ tyajanti na mahāntaḥ |
kiṃ hasatha kiṃ pradhāvatha kiṃ janam āhvayatha bālakā viphalam |
tad atha darśayati yathāriṣṭaḥ kaṇṭhe.munā jagṛhe ||
yoktuṃ na moktum athavā valate.sāv arthalabdharatiḥ ||
ketakagarbhe gandhādareṇa dūrād amī drutam upetāḥ |
ko vakrimā guṇāḥ ke kā kāntiḥ śiśirakiraṇalekhānām |
icchati saubhāgyam adāt svayaṃvareṇa śriyaṃ viṣṇuḥ ||
kāntaḥ padena hata iti saralām aparādhya kiṃ prasādayatha |
so .py evam eva sulabhaḥ padaprahāraḥ prasādaḥ kim ||
karṇagateyam amoghā dṛṣṭis tava śaktir indradattā ca |
kleśayasi kim iti dūtīr yad aśakyaṃ sumukhi tava kaṭākṣeṇa |
kāmo .pi tatra sāyakam akīrtiśaṅkī na saṃdhatte ||
ko veda mūlyam akṣadyūte prabhuṇā paṇīkṛtasya vidhoḥ |
prativijaye yat pratipaṇam adharaṃ gharanandinī vidadhe ||
kupitāṃ caraṇapraharaṇabhayena muñcāmi na khalu caṇḍi tvām |
kāmenāpi na bhettuṃ kimu hṛdayam apāri bālavanitānām |
kiṃ parajīvair dīvyasi vismayamadhurākṣi gaccha sakhi dūram |
roṣayati paruṣavacanais tathā tathā preyasīṃ rasikaḥ ||
kas tāṃ nindati lumpati kaḥ smaraphalakasya varṇakaṃ mugdhaḥ |
ko bhavati ratnakaṇṭakam amṛte kasyārucir udeti ||
karakampitakaravāle smara iva sā mūrchitā sutanuḥ ||
kuta iha kuraṅgaśāvaka kedāre kalam amañjarīṃ tyajasi |
khalasakhyaṃ prāṅ madhuraṃ vayo .ntarāle nidāghadinam ante |
guṇam adhigatam api dhanavān na cirān nāśayati rakṣati daridraḥ |
majjayati rajjum ambhasi pūrṇaḥ kumbhaḥ sakhi na tucchaḥ ||
gurur api laghūpanīto na nimajjati niyatam āśaye mahataḥ |
gaurīpater garīyo garalaṃ gatvā gale jīrṇam |
jīryati karṇe mahatāṃ durvādo nālpam api viśati ||
prīṇayati pīḍayati ca bālā niḥśvasya niḥśvasya ||
snigdhāṃ priye sagarvāṃ sakhīṣu bālā dṛśaṃ diśati ||
guṇabaddhacaraṇa iti mā līlāvihagaṃ vimuñca sakhi mugdhe |
bālā cumbati jāraṃ vajrād adhiko hi madaneṣuḥ ||
gṛhiṇīguṇeṣu gaṇitā vinayaḥ sevā vidheyateti guṇāḥ |
guṇam āntaram aguṇaṃ vā lakṣmīr gaṅgā ca veda hariharayoḥ |
ekā pade.pi ramate na vasati nihitā śirasy aparā ||
gatvā jīvitasaṃśayam abhyastaḥ soḍhum aticirād virahaḥ |
akaruṇaḥ punar api ditsasi suratadurabhyāsam asmākam ||
niḥśvasya mogharūpe svavapuṣi nihitaṃ tayā cakṣuḥ ||
guruṣu militeṣu śirasā praṇamasi laghuṣūnnatā sameṣu samā |
ucitajñāsi tule kiṃ tulayasi guñjāphalaiḥ kanakam ||
mama naukādvitayārpitaguṇa iva hṛdayaṃ dvidhā bhavati ||
lūtātantubhir iva kiṃ guṇair vimardāsahair bahubhiḥ ||
gāyati gīte vaṃśe vādayati sa vipañcīṣu |
gaṇayati na madhuvyayam ayam aviratam āpibatu madhukaraḥ kumudam |
guṇavidhṛtā sakhi tiṣṭhasi tathaiva dehena kiṃ tu hṛdayaṃ te |
gurusadane nedīyasi caraṇagate mayi ca mūkayāpi tayā |
nūpuram apāsya padayoḥ kiṃ na priyam īritaṃ priyayā ||
granthilatayā kim ikṣoḥ kim apabhraṃśena bhavati gītasya |
kim anārjavena śaśinaḥ kiṃ dāridryeṇa dayitasya ||
āliṅganty api bālā vadaty asau muñca muñceti ||
ghaṭitapalāśakapāṭaṃ niśi niśi sukhino hi śerate padmāḥ |
ujjāgareṇa kairava kati śakyā rakṣituṃ lakṣmīḥ ||
caṇḍi prasāritena spṛśan bhujenāpi kopanāṃ bhavatīm |
tṛpyāmi paṅkilām iva piban nadīṃ nalinanālena ||
dhūlibhayād api na mayā caraṇahṛtau kuñcitaṃ cakṣuḥ ||
caraṇaiḥ parāgasaikatam aphalam idaṃ likhasi madhupa ketakyāḥ |
capalāṃ yathā madāndhaś chāyāmayam ātmanaḥ karo hanti |
āsphālayati karaṃ pratigajas tathāyaṃ puro ruddhaḥ ||
chāyāgrāhī candraḥ kūṭatvaṃ satatam ambujaṃ vrajati |
jalabindavaḥ katipaye nayanād gamanodyame tava skhalitāḥ |
kānte mama gantavyā bhūr etair eva picchilitā ||
jāgaritvā puruṣaṃ paraṃ vane sarvato mukhaṃ harasi |
ati śaradanurūpaṃ tava śīlam idaṃ jātiśālinyāḥ ||
ḍhakkām āhatya madaṃ vitanvate kariṇa iva ciraṃ puruṣāḥ |
strīṇāṃ kariṇīnām iva madaḥ punaḥ svakulanāśāya ||
tāṃ tāpayanti manmathabāṇās tvāṃ prīṇayanti bata subhaga |
tyakto muñcati jīvanam ujhati nānugrahe.pi lolutvam |
kiṃ prāvṛṣeva padmākarasya karaṇīyam asya mayā ||
tvayi viniveśitacittā subhaga gatā kevalena kāyena |
tvayi saṃsaktaṃ tasyāḥ kaṭhoratara hṛdayam asamaśarataralam |
tvam asūryaṃpaśyā sakhi padam api na vināpavāraṇaṃ bhramasi |
chāye kim iha vidheyaṃ muñcanti na mūrtimantas tvām ||
bisinīva māghamāse vinā hutāśane sā dagdhā ||
kuṭilacaritā sapatnī na pibati bata śokavikalāpi ||
talpe prabhur iva gurur iva manasijatantre śrame bhujiṣyeva |
gehe śrīr iva gurujanapurato mūrteva sā vrīḍā ||
tvam alabhyā mama tāvan moktum aśaktasya saṃmukhaṃ vrajataḥ |
tapasā kleśita eṣa prauḍhabalo na khalu phālgune.py āsīt |
madhunā pramattam adhunā ko madanaṃ mihiram iva sahate ||
viddhā tadekaneyā potriṇa iva daṃṣṭrayā dharaṇī ||
tvayi kugrāmavaṭadruma vaiśravaṇo vasatu vā lakṣmīḥ |
tava mukhara vadanadoṣaṃ sahamānā moktum akṣamā sutanuḥ |
sā vahati viṭa bhavantaṃ ghuṇamantaḥ śālabhañjīva ||
tṛṇamukham iva na khalu tvāṃ tyajanty amī hariṇa vairiṇaḥ śabarāḥ |
tripuraripor iva gaṅgā mama mānini janitamadanadāhasya |
sa khalu sakhīnāṃ nibhṛtaṃ tvayā kṛtārthīkṛtaḥ subhagaḥ ||
tvayi sarpati pathi dṛṣṭiḥ sundara vṛtivivaranirgatā tasyāḥ |
te sutanu śūnyahṛdayā ye śaṅkhaṃ śūnyahṛdayam abhidadhati |
te śreṣṭhinaḥ kva samprati śakradhvaja yaiḥ kṛtas tavocchrāyaḥ |
īṣāṃ vā meḍhiṃ vādhunātanās tvāṃ vidhitsanti ||
karṇa iva kāminīnāṃ na śobhate nirbharaḥ premā ||
tasmin gatārdrabhāve vītarase śuṇṭhiśakala iva puruṣe |
tamasi ghane viṣame pathi jambukam ulkāmukhaṃ prapannāḥ smaḥ |
kiṃ kurmaḥ so .pi sakhe sthito mukhaṃ mudrayitvaiva ||
tvām abhilaṣato mānini mama garimaguṇo .pi doṣatāṃ yātaḥ |
paṅkilakūlāṃ taṭinīṃ yiyāsataḥ sindhur asy eva ||
timire.pi dūradṛśyā kaṭhināśleṣe ca rahasi mukharā ca |
hārasraja iva sundari kṛtaḥ punar nāyakas taralaḥ ||
pathi pathi gaganāśleṣaḥ kāmini kas te.bhisāraguṇaḥ ||
durjanasahavāsād api śīlotkarṣaṃ na sajjanas tyajati |
dayitaprahitāṃ dūtīm ālambya kareṇa tamasi gacchantī |
dākṣiṇyān mradimānaṃ dadhataṃ mā bhānum enam avamaṃsthāḥ |
raudrīm upāgate.smin kaḥ kṣamate dṛṣṭim api dātum ||
āśleṣo bālānāṃ bhavati khalānāṃ ca sambhedaḥ ||
dvāre guravaḥ koṇe śukaḥ sakāśe śiśur gṛhe sakhyaḥ |
dalitodvegena sakhi priyeṇa lagnena rāgam āvahatā |
hṛdayaṃ kareṇa tāḍitam atha mithyā vyañjitatrapayā ||
kṣiptahale haladhara iva sarvaṃ puramarjitaṃ sutanu ||
vyathayati virahe bakulaḥ kva paricayaḥ prakṛtikaṭhinānām ||
dvitrair eṣyāmi dinair iti kiṃ tad vacasi sakhi tavāśvāsaḥ |
kathayati cirapathikaṃ taṃ dūranikhāto nakhāṅkas te ||
duṣṭagraheṇa gehini tena kuputreṇa kiṃ prajātena |
hīrair apsv api vīrair āpatsv api gamyate nādhaḥ ||
mugdhe tava dṛṣṭir asāv arjunayantreṣur iva hanti ||
durgatagṛhiṇī tanaye karuṇārdrā priyatame ca rāgamayī |
mugdhā ratābhiyogaṃ na manyate na pratikṣipati ||
doṣā api bhūṣāyai gaṇikāyāḥ śaśikalāyāś ca ||
daratarale.kṣaṇi vakṣasi daronnate tava mukhe ca darahasite |
dalite palālapuñje vṛṣabhaṃ paribhavati gṛhapatau kupite |
dīpyantāṃ ye dīptyai ghaṭitā maṇayaś ca vīrapuruṣāś ca |
tejaḥ svavināśāya tu nṛṇāṃ tṛṇānām iva laghūnām ||
dhūmair aśru nipātaya daha śikhayā dahanamalinayāṅgāraiḥ |
jāgarayiṣyati durgatagṛhiṇī tvāṃ tad api śiśiraniśi ||
dhairyaṃ nidhehi gacchatu rajanī so .py astu sumukhi sotkaṇṭhaḥ |
praviśa hṛdi tasya dūraṃ kṣaṇadhṛtamuktā smareṣur iva ||
na hasanti jaraṭha iti yadvallavavanitā namanti nandam api |
nītā svabhāvam arpitavapur api vāmyaṃ na kāminī tyajati |
nipatati padaṃ na bhūmau jñātipuras tantuvāyasya ||
nipatati caraṇe koṇe praviśya niśi yan nirīkṣate kas tat |
sakhi sa khalu lokapurataḥ khalaḥ svagarimāṇam udgirati ||
na vimocayituṃ śakyaḥ kṣamāṃ mahān mocito yadi kathaṃcit |
mandaragirir iva garalaṃ nivartate nanu samutthāpya ||
vahatām api mahimānaṃ śobhāyai sajjanā eva ||
nottapane na snehaṃ harati na nirvāti na malino bhavati |
tasyojjvalo niśi niśi premā ratnapradīpa iva ||
nihitān nihitān ujhati niyataṃ mama pārthivān api prema |
bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ tiṣṭhati tatraiva kulālacakram iva ||
nirbharam api saṃbhuktaṃ dṛṣṭyā prātaḥ piban na tṛpyāmi |
nirguṇa iti mṛta iti ca dvāvekārthābhidhāyinau viddhi |
paśya dhanurguṇaśūnyaṃ nirjīvaṃ tad iha śaṃsanti ||
nijasūkṣmasūtralambī vilocanaṃ taruṇa te kṣaṇaṃ haratu |
ayam udgṛhītabaḍiśaḥ karkaṭa iva markaṭaḥ purataḥ ||
nāgara gītir ivāsau grāmasthityāpi bhūṣitā sutanuḥ |
nītā laghimānam iyaṃ tasyāṃ garimāṇam adhikam arpayasi |
bhāra iva viṣamabhāryaḥ sudurvaho bhavati gṛhavāsaḥ ||
na ca dūtī na ca yācñā na cāñjalir na ca kaṭākṣavikṣepaḥ |
nirmokaṃ ca bhujaṅgī muñcati puruṣaṃ ca vāravadhūḥ ||
nāhaṃ vadāmi sutanu tvam aśīlā vā pracaṇḍacaritā vā |
premasvabhāvasulabhaṃ bhayam udayati mama tu hṛdayasya ||
hārayati yena kusumaṃ vimukhe tvayi kaṇṭha iva deve ||
na guṇe na lakṣaṇe.pi ca vayasi ca rūpe ca nādaro vihitaḥ |
na prāpyase karābhyāṃ hṛdayān nāpaiṣi vitanuṣe bādhām |

yat khalu tejas tad akhilam ojāyitam abjamitrasya ||
na savarṇo na ca rūpaṃ na saṃskriyā kāpi naiva sā prakṛtiḥ |
na vibhūṣaṇe tavāsthā vapurguṇenaiva jayasi sakhi yūnaḥ |
netrākṛṣṭo bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ preyān yathā yathāsti tathā |
sakhi manthayati mano mama dadhibhāṇḍaṃ manthadaṇḍa iva ||
pathikāsaktā kiṃcin na veda ghanakalam agopitā gopī |
praṇamati paśyati cumbati saṃśliṣyati pulakamukulitair aṅgaiḥ |
praviśasi na ca nirgantuṃ jānāsi vyākulatvam ātanuṣe |
api ca picumandamukule maukulikulam ākulaṃ milati ||
tvāṃ sakhi paśyāmi tathā chāyām iva saṃkucanmānām ||
prāṅgaṇakoṇe.pi niśāpatiḥ sa tāpaṃ sudhāmayo harati |
yadi māṃ rajanijvara iva sakhi sa na niruṇaddhi gehapatiḥ ||
abhisarati subhaga sā tvāṃ vidalantī kaṇṭakaṃ tamasi ||
pratibhūḥ śuko vipakṣe daṇḍaḥ śṛṅgārasaṃkathā guruṣu |
paramohanāya mukto niṣkaruṇe taruṇi tava kaṭākṣo .yam |
viśikha iva kalitakarṇaḥ praviśati hṛdayaṃ na niḥsarati ||
prātar upāgatya mṛṣā vadataḥ sakhi nāsya vidyate vrīḍā |
vairāṭir iva pataṅgaḥ pratyānayanaṃ karoti gavām ||
pramadavanaṃ tava ca stanaśailaṃ mūlaṃ gabhīrasarasāṃ ca |
proñchati tavāparādhaṃ mānaṃ mardayati nirvṛtiṃ harati |
svakṛtān nihanti śapathāñ jāgaradīrghā niśā subhaga ||
priya āyāte dūrād abhūta iva saṅgamo .bhavat pūrvaḥ |

column5: jyām arpayituṃ namitā kusumāstradhanur lateva madhu ||

column3: puṃsāṃ darśaya sundari mukhendum īṣat trpām apākṛtya |
jāyājita iti rūḍhā janaśrutir me yaśo bhavatu ||
prasaratu śarattriyāmā jaganti dhavalayatu dhāma tuhināṃśoḥ |
vakṣyanti sāṅgarāgāḥ pathi taravas tava samādhānam ||
kāñcīguṇa iva patitaḥ sthitaikaratnaḥ phaṇī sphurati ||
capalāntara ghana kiṃ tava vacanīyaṃ pavanavaśyo .si ||
nijanāyakam atikṛpaṇaṃ kathayati kugrāma iva viralaḥ ||
pathikaṃ śrameṇa suptaṃ darataralā taruṇi sumadhuracchāyā |
yā luptakīlabhāvaṃ yātā hṛdi bahir adṛśyāsi ||
prātar nidrāti yathā yathātmajā lulitaniḥsahair aṅgaiḥ |
jāmātari muditamanās tathā tathā sādarā śvaśrūḥ ||
priyadurnayena hṛdaya sphuṭasi yadi sphuṭanam api tava ślāghyam |
prakaṭayasi rāgam adhikaṃ lapanam idaṃ vakrimāṇam āvahati |
prīṇayati ca pratipadaṃ dūti śukasyeva dayitasya ||
pūrvair eva caritair jarato .pi pūjyatā bhavataḥ |
muñca madam asya gandhād yuvabhir gaja gaūjanīyo .si ||
prathamaṃ praveśitā yā vāsāgāraṃ kathañcana sakhībhiḥ |
na śṛṇotīva prātaḥ sā nirgamanasya saṅketam ||
pūjā vinā pratiṣṭhāṃ nāsti na mantraṃ vinā pratiṣṭhā ca |
bhīr adhikeyaṃ kathayati rāgaṃ bālāvibhaktam iva ||
priya āyāto dūrād iti yā prītir babhūva gehinyāḥ |
pathikebhyaḥ pūrvāgata iti garvāt sāpi śataśikharā ||
pṛṣṭhaṃ prayaccha mā spṛśa dūrād apasarpa vihitavaimukhya |
tvām anudhāvati taraṇis tad api guṇākarṣataraleyam ||
prāṅgaṇa eva kadā māṃ śliṣyantī manykampikucakalaśā |
aṃsaniṣaṇṇamukhī sā snapayati bāṣpeṇa mama pṛṣṭham ||
pretaiḥ praśastasattvā sāśru vṛkair vīkṣitā skhaladgrāsaiḥ |
piśunaḥ khalu sujanānāṃ khalam eva puro vidhāya jetavyaḥ |
kṛtvā jvaram ātmīyaṃ jigāya bāṇaṃ raṇe viṣṇuḥ ||
piba madhupa bakulakalikāṃ dūre rasanāgramātram ādhāya |
prāyeṇaiva hi malinā malinānām āśrayatvam upayānti |
parapaṭa iva rajakībhir malino bhuktvāpi nirdayaṃ tābhiḥ |
balam api vasati mayīti śreṣṭhini gurugarvagadgadaṃ vadati |
bāṇaṃ harir iva kurute sujano bahudoṣam apy adoṣam iva |
yāvad doṣaṃ jāgrati malimlucā iva punaḥ piśunāḥ ||
bauddhasyeva kṣaṇiko yadyapi bahuvallabhasya tava bhāvaḥ |
bhagnā bhagnā bhrūr iva na tu tasyā vighaṭate maitrī ||
bāṣpākulaṃ pralapator gṛhiṇi nivartasva kānta gaccheti |
bhramasi prakaṭayasi radaṃ karaṃ prasārayasi tṛṇam api śrayasi |
dhiṅ mānaṃ tava kuñjara jīvaṃ na juhoṣi jaṭharāgnau ||
bhūtimayaṃ kurute.gnis tṛṇam api saṃlagnam enam api bhajataḥ |
bhavati nidāghe dīrghe yatheha yamuneva yāminī tanvī |
dvīpā iva divasā api tathā krameṇa prathīyāṃsaḥ ||
tanvī hastenāpi spraṣṭum aśuddhair na sā śakyā ||
bhavatāliṅgi bhujaṃgī jātaḥ kila bhogicakravartī tvam |
kañcuka vanecarīstanam abhilaṣataḥ sphurati laghimā te ||
rakṣaka jayasi yad ekaḥ śūnye surasadasi sukham asmi ||
vṛddhasya pramadāpi śrīr api bhṛtyasya bhogāya ||
bhavitāsi rajani yasyām adhvaśramaśāntaye padaṃ dadhatīm |
sa balād valayitajaṅghābaddhāṃ mām urasi pātayati ||
puruṣasya ca kanakasya ca yukto garimā sarāgasya ||
bhasmapuruṣe.pi giriśe snehamayī tvam ucitena subhagāsi |
bhramarīva koṣagarbhe gandhahṛtā kusumam anusarantī tvām |
avyaktaṃ kūjantī saṅketaṃ tamasi sā bhramati ||
bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ sthitayā snehe tava payasi tatra tatraiva |
tad api tamomaya eva tvam īśa kaḥ prakṛtim atiśete ||
madhumadavītavrīḍā yathā yathā lapati saṃmukhaṃ bālā |
tanmukham ajātatṛptis tathā tathā vallabhaḥ pibati ||
mitrair ālocya samaṃ guru kṛtvā kadanam api samārabdhaḥ |
arthaḥ satām iva hato mukhavailakṣyeṇa māno .yam ||
mama rāgiṇo manasvini karam arpayato dadāsi pṛṣṭham api |
yadi tad api kamalabandhor iva manye svasya saubhāgyam ||
mā spṛśa mām iti sakupitam iva bhaṇitaṃ vyañjitā na ca vrīḍā |
mūlāni ca niculānāṃ hṛdayāni ca kūlavasatikulaṭānām |
madhumathanamaulimāle sakhi tulayasi tulasi kiṃ mudhā rādhām |
yat tava padam adasīyaṃ surabhayituṃ saurabhodbhedaḥ ||
mṛgamadanidānam aṭavī kuṅkumam api kṛṣakavāṭikā vahati |
madhudivaseṣu bhrāmyan yathā viśati mānasaṃ bhramaraḥ |
mayi calite tava muktā dṛśaḥ svabhāvāt priye sapānīyāḥ |
satyam amūlyāḥ sadyaḥ prayānti mama hṛdayahāratvam ||
mugdhe mama manasi śarāḥ smarasya pañcāpi santataṃ lagnāḥ |
śaṅke stanaguṭikādvayam arpitam etena tava hṛdaye ||
hanta haranti mano mama nalikāviśikhāḥ smarasyeva ||
sajjanayoḥ stanayor iva nirantaraṃ saṃgataṃ bhavati ||
mama vāritasya bahubhir bhūyo bhūyaḥ svayaṃ ca bhāvayataḥ |
jāto diśīva tasyāṃ sakhe na vinivartate mohaḥ ||
yady ucyase taruvara bhraṣṭo bhraṃśo .pi te ślāghyaḥ ||
menām ullāsayati smerayati hariṃ giriṃ ca vimukhayati |
medinyāṃ tava nipatati na padaṃ bahuvallabheti garveṇa |
āśliṣya kair na taruṇais turīva vasanair vimuktāsi ||
mūle nisargamadhuraṃ samarpayanto rasaṃ puro virasāḥ |
ikṣava iva parapuruṣā vividheṣu raseṣu vinidheyāḥ ||
mahati snehe nihitaḥ kusumaṃ bahu dattam arcito bahuśaḥ |
vakras tad api śanaiścara iva sakhi duṣṭagraho dayitaḥ ||
mā śabarataruṇi pīvaravakṣoruhayor bhareṇa bhaja garvam |
nirmokair api śobhā yayor bhujaṅgībhir unmuktaiḥ ||
mama kupitāyāś chāyāṃ bhūmāv āliṅgya sakhi milatpulakaḥ |
snehamayatvam anujjhan karoti kiṃ naiṣa mām aruṣam ||
muṣita iva kṣaṇavirahe ripur iva kusumeṣukelisaṅgrāme |
dāsa iva śramasamaye bhajan natāṅgīṃ na tṛpyāmi ||
snehabhavaḥ payasāgniḥ sāntvena ca roṣa unmiṣati ||
malayajam apasārya ghanaṃ vījanavighnaṃ vidhāya bāhubhyām |
mahato .pi hi viśvāsān mahāśayā dadhati nālpam api laghavaḥ |
madhudhāreva na muñcasi mānini rūkṣāpi mādhurīṃ sahajām |
kṛtamukhabhaṅgāpi rasaṃ dadāsi mama sarid ivāmbhodheḥ ||
mama bhayam asyāḥ kopo nirvedo .syā mamāpi mandākṣam |
muktāmbaraiva dhāvatu nipatatu sahasā trimārgagā vāstu |
mṛgamadalepanam enaṃ nīlanicolaiva niśi niṣeva tvam |
mama sakhyā nayanapathe militaḥ śakto na kaścid api calitum |
mahatā priyeṇa nirmitam apriyam api subhaga sahyatāṃ yāti |
mānagrahagurukopād anu dayitāty eva rocate mahyam |
vana iva pure.pi vicarati puruṣaṃ tvām eva jānantī ||
antarbhavati bhavatsv api nābhaktas tan na vijñātam ||
yatra na dūtī yatra snigdhā na dṛśo .pi nipuṇayā nihitāḥ |
yā nīyate sapatny praviśya yāvarjitā bhujaṅgena |
yamunāyā iva tasyāḥ sakhi malinaṃ jīvanaṃ manye ||
yasminnayaśo .pi yaśo hrīr vighno māna eva dauḥśīlyam |
laghutā guṇajñatā kiṃ navo yuvā sakhi na te dṛṣṭaḥ ||
yad vīkṣyate khalānāṃ māhātmyaṃ kvāpi daivayogena |
kākānām iva śauklyaṃ tad api hi na cirād anarthāya ||
yat khalu khalamukhahutavahavinihitam api śuddhim eva parameti |
tad analaśaucam ivāṃśukam iha loke durlabhaṃ prema ||
yan nāvadhim arthayate pātheyārthaṃ dadāti sarvasvam |
nadayor ivaiṣa yuvayoḥ saṅgo rasam adhikam āvahatu ||
yan nihitāṃ śekharayasi mālāṃ sā yātu śaṭha bhavantam iti |
praharantīṃ śirasi padā smarāmi tāṃ garvagurukopām ||
yauvanaguptiṃ patyau bandhuṣu mugdhatvam ārjavaṃ guruṣu |
yo na gurubhir na mitrair na vivekenāpi naiva ripuhasitaiḥ |
niyamitapūrvaḥ sundari sa vinītatvaṃ tvayā nītaḥ ||
yanmūlam ārdram udakaiḥ kusumaṃ pratiparva phalabharaḥ paritaḥ |
kim iti madapaṅkamalināṃ karī kapolasthalīṃ vahati ||
yamunātaraṅgataralaṃ na kuvalayaṃ kusumalāvi tava sulabham |
yadi saurabhānusārī jhaṅkārī bhramati na bhramaraḥ ||
bhavati bhavanaṃ tad anyat prāgvaṃśaḥ parṇaśālā vā ||
rogo rājāyata iti janavādaṃ satyam adya kalayāmi |
ruddhasvarasaprasarasyālibhir agre nataṃ priyaṃ prati me |
srotasa iva nimnaṃ prati rāgasya dviguṇa āvegaḥ ||
rūpam idaṃ kāntir asāv ayam utkarṣaḥ suvarṇaracaneyam |
rakṣati na khalu nijasthitim alaghuḥ sthāpayati nāyakaḥ sa yathā |
prathayati pṛghuguṇaneyā taruṇī taraṇir iva garimāṇam ||
sasmitasalajjam īkṣitam idam iṣṭaṃ siddham ācaṣṭe ||
roṣo .pi rasavatīnāṃ na karkaśo vā cirānubandhī vā |
varṣāṇām upalo .pi hi susnigdhaḥ kṣaṇikakalpaś ca ||
rodanam etad dhanyaṃ sakhi kiṃ bahu mṛtyur api mamānarghaḥ |
roṣeṇaiva mayā sakhi vakro .pi granthilo .pi kaṭhino .pi |
ṛjutām anīyatāyaṃ sadyaḥ svedena vaṃśa iva ||
rajanīm iyam upanetuṃ pitṛprasūḥ prathamam upatasthe |
lagnāsi kṛṣṇavartmani susnigdhe varti hanta dagdhāsi |
ayam akhilanayanasubhago nu bhuktamuktāṃ punaḥ spṛśati ||
lakṣmīḥ śikṣayati guṇān amūn punar durgatir vidhūnayati |
pūrṇo bhavati suvṛttas tuṣārarucir apacaye vakraḥ ||
vapre saktaṃ dvipam iva śṛṅgāras tvāṃ vibhūṣayati ||
liptaṃ na mukhaṃ nāṅgaṃ na pakṣatī na caraṇāḥ parāgeṇa |
lagnaṃ jaghane tasyāḥ śuṣyati nakhalakṣma mānasaṃ ca mama |
līlāgārasya bahiḥ sakhīṣu caraṇātithau mayi priyayā |
varṇahṛtir na lalāṭe na lulitam aṅgaṃ na cādhare daṃśaḥ |
utpalam ahāri vāri ca na spṛṣṭam upāyacatureṇa ||
śrīr api vīravadhūr api garvotpulakā sukhaṃ svapiti ||
bhindanti pṛṣṭhapatitāḥ priya hṛdayaṃ mama tava śvāsāḥ ||
vyaktam adhunā sametaḥ khaṇḍo madirākṣi daśanavasane te |
yan navasudhaikasāre lobhini tat kim api nādrākṣam ||
sanmaitrīva śroṇī paraṃ nidāghe.pi na vighaṭitā ||
vyāroṣaṃ māninyās tamo divaḥ kāsaraṃ kalam abhūmeḥ |
vakṣasi vijṛmbhamāṇe stanabhinnaṃ truṭati kañcukaṃ tasyāḥ |
pūrvadayitānurāgas tava hṛdi na manāg api truṭati ||
vyaktim avekṣya tad anyāṃ tasyām eveti viditam adhunā tu |
harmyaharimukham iva tvām ubhayoḥ sādhāraṇaṃ vedmi ||
añcalam iva cañcalatāṃ mama sakhyāḥ prāpitaṃ cetaḥ ||
vitarantī rasam antar mamārdrabhāvaṃ tanoṣi tanugātri |
antaḥsalilā sarid iva yan nivasasi bahir adṛśyāpi ||
labhate kutaḥ prabodhaṃ sa jāgaritvaiva nidrāṇaḥ ||
ketakaviṭapa kim etair nanu vāraya mañjarīgandham ||
vicalasi mugdhe vidhṛtā yathā tathā viśasi hṛdayamadaye me |
puruṣāyite virājati dehas tava sakhi śikhaṇḍīva ||
vrīḍāprasaraḥ prathamaṃ tad anu ca rasabhāvapuṣṭaceṣṭeyam |
javanīvinirgamād anu naṭīva dayitā mano harati ||
vāsasi haridrayeva tvayi gaurāṅgyā niveśito rāgaḥ |
kvacid api kuraṅga bhavato nābhīm ādāya na sthānam ||
vaṭam ekam anusarantī jāhnavi luṭhasi prayāgataṭe ||
veda caturṇāṃ kṣaṇadā praharāṇāṃ saṅgamaṃ viyogaṃ ca |
caraṇānām iva kūrmī saṅkocam api prasāram api ||
vṛtivivareṇa viśantī subhaga tvām īkṣituṃ sakhīdṛṣṭiḥ |
dharmaghaṭo .sāv adharīkaroti laghum upari nayati gurum ||
vāsaragamyam anūror ambaram avanī ca vāmanaikapadam |
jaladhir api potalaṅghyaḥ satāṃ manaḥ kena tulayāmaḥ ||
viparītam api rataṃ te sroto nadyā ivānukūlam idam |
taṭatarum iva mama hṛdayaṃ samūlam api vegato harati ||
vaibhavabhājāṃ dūṣaṇam api bhūṣaṇapakṣa eva nikṣiptam |
ugṇam ātmanām adharmaṃ dveṣaṃ ca gṛṇanti kāṇādāḥ ||
kaṃ vañcayanti na sakhe khalāś ca gaṇikākaṭākṣāś ca ||
vyajanādibhir upacāraiḥ kiṃ marupathikasya gṛhiṇi vihitair me |
vaiguṇye.pi hi mahatā vinirmitaṃ bhavati karma śobhāyai |
vīkṣya satīnāṃ gaṇane rekhām ekāṃ tayā svanāmāṅkām |
santu yuvāno hasituṃ svayam evāpāri nāvaritum ||
vaṃśāvalambanaṃ yad yo vistāro guṇasya yāvanatiḥ |
āyātasya padaṃ mama gehinyā tad anu salilena ||
vakṣaḥsthalasupte mama mukham upadhātuṃ na maulim ālabhase |
śrīr api bhujaṅgabhoge mohanavijñena śīlitā yena |
so .pi hariḥ puruṣo yadi puruṣā itare.pi kiṃ kurmaḥ ||
śaṅke yā sthairyamayī ślathayati bāhū manobhavasyāpi |
darpaśilām iva bhavatīṃ kataras taruṇo vicālayati ||
bālānām api bālāsāyasyās tvam api hṛdi vasasi ||
śruta eva śrutihāriṇi rāgotkarṣeṇa kaṇṭham adhivasati |
gīta iva tvayi madhure karoti nārthagrahaṃ sutanuḥ ||
śroṇī bhūmāv aṅke priyo bhayaṃ manasi patibhuje mauliḥ |
gūḍhaśvāso vadane suratam idaṃ cet tṛṇaṃ tridivam ||
śliṣyann iva cumbann iva paśyann iva collikhann ivātṛptaḥ |
dadhad iva hṛdayasyāntaḥ smarāmi tasyā muhur jaghanam ||
śirasi caraṇaprahāraṃ pradāya niḥsāryatāṃ sa te tad api |
cakrāṅkito bhujaṅgaḥ kāliya iva sumukhi kālindyāḥ ||
śocyaiva sā kṛśāṅgī bhūtimayī bhavatu guṇamayī vāpi |
snehaikavaśya bhavatā tyaktā dīpena vartir iva ||
acalaiva kīrtyate bhūḥ kim aśakyaṃ nāma vasumatyāḥ ||
śyāmā vilocanaharī bāleyaṃ manasi hanta sajantī |
śataśo gatir āvṛttiḥ śataśaḥ kaṇṭhāvalambanaṃ śataśaḥ |
śataśo yāmīti vacaḥ smarāmi tasyāḥ pravāsadine ||
śirasā vahasi kapardaṃ rudra ruditvāpi rajatam arjayasi |
asyāpy udarasyārdhaṃ bhajatas tava vetti kas tattvam ||
duṣṭabhujaṅgaparīte tvaṃ ketaki na khalu naḥ spṛśyā ||
nādarapadam iha gaṇakāḥ pramāṇapuruṣo bhavān ekaḥ ||
śaithilyena bhṛtā api bhartuḥ kāryaṃ tyajanti na suvṛttāḥ |
tvāṃ muṣṭimeyamadhyām adhunā śaktiṃ smaro vahati ||
dvitither divasasya parā tithir iva sevyā niśi tvam asi ||
saubhāgyagarvam ekā karotu yūthasya bhūṣaṇaṃ kariṇī |
atyāyām avator yā madāndhayor madhyam adhivasati ||
aparāddhā subhaga tvāṃ svayam aham anunetum āyātā ||
cālayati pārthivān api yaḥ sa kulālaḥ paraṃ cakrī ||
sarale na veda bhavatī bahubhaṅgā bahurasā bahuvivartā |
sakhi śṛṇu mama priyo .yaṃ gehaṃ yenaiva vartmanāyātaḥ |
sāyaṃ ravir analam asau madanaśaraṃ sa ca viyoginīcetaḥ |
idam api tamaḥsamūhaṃ so .pi nabho nirbharaṃ viśati ||
svayam upanītair aśanaiḥ puṣṇantī nīḍanirvṛtaṃ dayitam |
svarasena badhnatāṃ karam ādāne kaṇṭakotkarais tudatām |
saubhāgyaṃ dākṣiṇyān nety upadiṣṭaṃ hareṇa taruṇīnām |
subhaga svabhavanabhittau bhavatā saṃmardya pīḍitā sutanuḥ |
sā pīḍayaiva jīvati dadhatī vaidyeṣu vidveṣam ||
apasarasi sundari yathā yathā tathā spṛśasi mama hṛdayam ||
sakhi sukhayaty avakāśaprāptaḥ preyān yathā tathā na gṛhī |
vātād avāritād api bhavati gavākṣānilaḥ śītaḥ ||
satatam aruṇitamukhe sakhi nigirantī garalam iva girāṃ gumpham |
anayā sevita pavana tvaṃ kiṃ kṛtamalayabhṛgupātaḥ ||
sarvāṅgam arpayantī lolā suptaṃ śrameṇa śayyāyām |
alasam api bhāgyavantaṃ bhajate puruṣayiteva śrīḥ ||
suditaṃ tad eva yatra smāraṃ smāraṃ viyogaduḥkhāni |
āliṅgati sā gāḍhaṃ punaḥ punar yāminīprathame ||
sāntarbhayaṃ bhujiṣyā yathā yathācarati samadhikāṃ sevām |
sundari darśayati yathā bhavadvipakṣasya tatsakhī kāntim |
patati tathā mama dṛṣṭis tvadekadāsasya sāsūyā ||
subhagā subhagety anayā sakhi nikhilā mukharitā pallī ||
sarita iva yasya gehe śuṣyanti viśālagotrajā nāryaḥ |
kṣārāsv eva sa tṛpyati jalanidhilaharīṣu jalada iva ||
giribhuva iva tava manye manaḥ śilā samabhavaccaṇḍi ||
khala iva durlakṣyas tava vinatamukhasyopari sthitaḥ kopaḥ ||
sarvāsām eva sakhe paya iva surataṃ manohāri |
tasyā eva punaḥ punar āvṛttau dugdham iva madhuram ||
svapne.pi yāṃ na muñcasi yā te.nugrāhiṇī hṛdisthāpi |
duṣṭāṃ na buddhim iva tāṃ gūḍhavyabhicāriṇīṃ vetsi ||
harasi kṣipasi taralayasi bhramayasi tolayasi pātayasi ||
sā bahulakṣaṇabhāvā strīmātraṃ veti kitava tava tulyam |
koṭir varāṭikā vā dyūtavidheḥ sarva eva paṇaḥ ||
sā virahadahanadūnā mṛtvā mṛtvāpi jīvati varākī |
sparśād eva svedaṃ janayati na ca me dadāti nidrātum |
pirya iva jaghanāṃśukam api na nidāghaḥ kṣaṇam api kṣamate ||
sā bhavato bhāvanayā samayaviruddhaṃ manobhavaṃ bālā |
spṛśati nakhair na ca vilikhati sicayaṃ gṛhṇāti na ca vimocayati |
na ca muñcati na ca madayati nayati niśāṃ sā na nidrāti ||
stanajaghanadvayam asyā laṅghitamadhyaḥ sakhe mama kaṭākṣaḥ |
ākopam etya vātāyanaṃ pidhāya sthitaṃ priyayā ||
sakhi na khalu nimalānāṃ vidadhaty abhidhānam api mukhe malināḥ |
svalpā iti rāmabalair ye nyastā nāśaye payorāśeḥ |
te śailāḥ sthitimanto hanta laghimnaiva bahumānaḥ ||
sotkampena mayā sakhi dṛṣṭā sā mādyati sma yathā ||
sakhi moghīkṛtamadane pativrate kas tavādaraṃ kurute |
nāśrauṣīr bhagavān api sa kāmaviddho haraḥ pūjyaḥ ||
sā mayi na dāsabuddhir na ratir nāpi trapā na viśvāsaḥ |
hanta nirīkṣya navoḍhāṃ manye vayam apiryā jātāḥ ||
sucirāyāte gṛhiṇī niśi bhuktā dinamukhe vidagdheyam |
priya kālapariṇatir iyaṃ virajyase yan nakhāṅka iva ||
sā vicchāyā niśi niśi sutanur bahutuhinaśītale talpe |
jvalati tvadīyavirahād oṣadhir iva himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe ||
sā nīrase tava hṛdi praviśati niryāti na labhate sthairyam |
sukumāratvaṃ kāntir nitāntasāratvam āntarāś ca guṇāḥ |
kiṃ nāma nendulekhe śaśagraheṇaiva tava kathitam ||
dharmārthināṃ tathāpi sa mṛgyaḥ pūjārtham aśvatthaḥ ||
satyaṃ svalpaguṇeṣu stabdhā sadṛśe punar bhujaṅge sā |
sarvaṃsahāṃ mahīm iva vidhāya tāṃ bāṣpavāribhiḥ pūrṇām |
bhavanāntaramayam adhunā saṃkrāntas te guruḥ premā ||
sambhavati na khalu rakṣā sarasānāṃ prakṛticapalacaritānām |
sā lajjitā sapatnī kupitā bhītaḥ priyaḥ sakhī sukhitā |
puṣyati ca mānacarcāṃ gṛhiṇī saphalayait cotkalikām ||
sā sarvathaiva raktā rāgaṃ guñjeva na tu mukhe vahati |
vacanapaṭos tava rāgaḥ kevalam āsye śukasyeva ||
uṣasi dadatī pradīpaṃ sakhībhir upahasyate bālā ||
sā tīkṣṇamānadahanā mahataḥ snehasya durlabhaḥ pākaḥ |
tvāṃ darvīm iva dūti prayāsayannasmi viśvastaḥ ||
na vitanute kam anarthaṃ dantini tava yauvanodbhaṭaḥ ||
sadanād apaiti dayito hasati sakhī viśati gharaṇim iva bālā |
jvalati sapatnī kīre jalpati mugdhe prasīdati ||
dayitāṃ bhajāmi mugdhām iva tuhina tava prasādena ||
sakhi lagnaiva vasantī sadāśaye mahati rasamaye tasya |
bāḍavaśikheva sindhor na manāg apy ārdratāṃ bhajasi ||
na sakhīnām api rudatī mamaiva vakṣaḥsthale patitā ||
udvartanaṃ na sakhyāḥ samāpyate kiṃcid apagaccha ||
puruṣā api viśikhā api guṇacyutāḥ kasya na bhayāya ||
dviradasya durjanasya ca madaṃ cakāraiva dānam api ||
satyaṃ patir avidagdhaḥ sā tu svadhiyaiva nidhuvane nipuṇā |
mārttikam ādhāya guruṃ dhanur adhigatam ekalavyena ||
sakhi mama karañjatailaṃ bahusaṃdeśaṃ praheṣyasīty uditā |
saṃdarśayanti sundari kulaṭānāṃ tamasi vitatam avikalpe |
sarvaṃ vanaṃ tṛṇālyā pihitaṃ pītāḥ sitāṃśuravitārāḥ |
samyag aniṣpannaḥ san yo .rthas tvarayā svayaṃ sphuṭīkriyate |
sa vyaṅga eva bhavati prathamo vinatātanūja iva ||
sajjana eva hi vidyā śobhanāyai bhavati durjane moghā |
subhagaṃ vadati janas taṃ nijapatir iti naiṣa rocate mahyam |
saudhagavākṣagatāpi hi dṛṣṭis taṃ sthitikṛtaprayatnam api |
sahagharmacāriṇī mama paricchadaḥ sutanu neha sandehaḥ |
sundari tāṭaṅkamayaṃ cakram ivodvahati tāvake karṇe |
sakhi durjanasya bhūtiḥ prasarati dūraṃ jvarasyeva ||
sukhayitatarāṃ na rakṣati paricayaleśaṃ gaṇāṅganeva śrīḥ |
hā gṛhiṇīti pralapaṃś cirāgataḥ sakhi patiḥ patitaḥ ||
saci caturānanabhāvād vaimukhyaṃ kvāpi naiva darśayati |
ayam ekahṛdaya eva druhiṇa iva priyatamas tad api ||
satyaṃ madhuro niyataṃ vakro nūnaṃ kalādharo dayitaḥ |
sa tu veda na dvitīyām akalaṅkaḥ pratipadindur iva ||
svasthānād api vicalati majjati jaladhau ca nīcam api bhajate |
saṃvṛṇu bāṣpajalaṃ sakhi dṛśam uparajyāñjanena valayainām |
dayitaḥ paśyatu pallavapaṅkajayor yugapad eva rucam ||
sā pāṇḍudurbalāṅgī nayasi tvaṃ yatra yāti tatraiva |
sakhi viśvagañjanīyā lakṣmīr iva kamalamukhi kadaryasya |
hṛdayajñayā gavākṣe visadṛkṣaṃ kimapi kūjitaṃ sakhyā |
yat kalahabhinnatalpā bhayakapaṭād eti māṃ sutanu ||
harati hṛdayaṃ śalākānihito .ñjanatantur eṣa sakhi mugdhe |
hasasi caraṇaprahāre talpād apasārito bhuvi svapiṣi |
nāsadṛśe.pi kṛte priya mama hṛdayāt tvaṃ viniḥsarasi ||
hasati sapatnī śvaśrū roditi vadanaṃ ca pidadhate sakhyaḥ |
aruṇas tapanaśilām iva punar na māṃ bhasmatāṃ nayati ||
hṛtvā taṭini taraṅgair bhramitaś cakreṣu nāśaye nihitaḥ |
kṣīrasya tu dayitatvaṃ yato .pi śāntopacāram āsādya |
kṣāntam apasārito yac caraṇāvupadhāya supta evāsi |
udghāṭayasi kim ūru niḥśvāsaiḥ pulakayann uṣṇaiḥ ||
kṣudrodbhavasya kaṭutāṃ prakaṭayato yacchataśca madam uccaiḥ |
madhuno laghupuruṣasya ca garimā laghimā ca bhedāya ||
vāgdevīṃ bhajato mama santaḥ paśyantu ko doṣaḥ ||
kasya na janayati harṣaṃ satkāvyaṃ madhuravacanaṃ ca ||
